caption:
Fabien Maman (my dad) did some initial research on the effect of sound on human cells. 

The findings helped spark the modern sound healing movement we see today. 

As a touring musician he toured to Asia where he learned acupuncture and meditation. 

He combined acupuncture with sound healing to form his unique form of sound healing with tuning forks on the acupuncture points. 

Personally I fell more in love with his meditations, and for me it’s been meditation that’s changed my life. 

If you would like to dive into the world of meditation, comment “meditate” to learn more. 

Speaker: @thesoundtheory 

Follow @benzamaman for daily inspiration on your journey 

#consciousness #newearth #soundhealing #soundhealingtherapy
